The embattled Senior Pastor of The Fountain of Life Church, Jimmy Odukoya, has recounted how his late father, Pastor Taiwo Odukoya, appeared to him in a dream during the leadership crisis rocking the church, saying the experience strengthened his resolve to resist pressure from members of the Board of Trustees. Jimmy disclosed this on Wednesday while addressing about 300 church workers at the church auditorium, where he gave his account of the prolonged dispute between him and some members of the board. According to Church Times, which reported the meeting, Odukoya arrived at the church premises in a convoy of about five vehicles, accompanied by security personnel, and addressed the workers at about 6.45 pm. The former Nollywood actor said he resorted to fasting and prayers during the crisis, asking God for direction on how to handle the disagreement. “I took to fasting and praying, asking God to speak to me on the matter. I gave God two options: to speak to me in a dream and to send someone I did not know to give me clarity on the matter. “In the course of the fasting and prayers, my late father appeared to me in a dream. The message I got from the dream was that I should not succumb to the threats of the Board of Trustees. He told me that they would try to throw dirt on me, but that I would overcome. He said the two experiences strengthened his resolve to maintain his position and subsequently ask members of the board, including his elder sister, to resign. Odukoya, however, said he pleaded with his sister that she would be reconsidered for membership after the church had been given a fresh start, but his sisters rejected the proposal while the board maintained its position. Explaining the origin of the leadership dispute, Odukoya said disagreements began about a year after he assumed leadership of the church, following allegations about his administration. He also alleged that his two sisters supported the board’s position, claiming that one of them, Tolu, had approached him to request that he step aside as chairman so she could assume the position. The disagreement reportedly escalated despite the intervention of Bishop Mike Okonkwo, who appealed to him to relinquish the board chairmanship. PUNCH Online had reported that some members of the board, following a November 16 meeting, withdrew recognition of Odukoya as senior pastor and announced Pastor Rotimi Okpaise as interim spiritual and administrative leader. The trustees based their decision partly on a video recorded in December 2021 in which the late founder reportedly named Pastor Kunle Areogun as his preferred successor, with Jimmy designated as Areogun’s administrative assistant and head of the youth church. The trustees alleged that the recording was not presented when they considered the succession arrangement that led to Jimmy’s appointment in September 2023, weeks after his father’s death in August of the same year. They also cited concerns about his remarriage and the public blessing of his marriage, which they said conflicted with the church’s teachings and standards for spiritual leadership. However, the church rejected the purported removal, describing it as unconstitutional and insisting that Odukoya remained its duly appointed senior pastor and chairman of the Board of Trustees. It maintained that his appointment was unanimously approved in September 2023 and alleged that the trustees behind the removal announcement had been asked to resign in March 2026 over alleged violations of the church’s constitution.
